evidence.observation: Heater temperature dropped from 283 to 268 then 240 °C, consistent with heater power cutback after reaching setpoint/boil-up
Reboiler temperature still rising smoothly (56.1 °C), column temperatures climbing in sequence
Transient spike to 5.7 mbar at k=19, back to 3.2 mbar

args.missing_evidence: Distillate composition (GC) measurement; continued trend of T701 and PDI701/PDI702 to confirm the heater dip and pressure blip are control transients rather than a fault
